title: Original Dexcom Reciver loses connection.
symptom: With xDrip version 210204 or newer, the original Dexcom receiver cannot establish a connection to the transmitter; xDrip itself still works. After going back to version 210203, the receiver reconnects and shows the new value.
cause: A change in xDrip code between 2021.02.03 and 2021.02.04 is the regression point; newer xDrip builds interfere with the original receiver because disabling xDrip's collection restores receiver operation. Low transmitter battery was initially suspected but ruled out when the problem continued with higher-voltage transmitters.
fix: No permanent code fix is offered; the workaround is to stay on xDrip version 210203, the last version where the original Dexcom receiver still works. With newer versions, temporarily selecting Settings -> Hardware Data Source -> Disable Collection lets the receiver connect again, but stops xDrip readings.
evidence_quote: Something changed, in the xDrip code, from Feb. 3 to Feb. 4 that is causing this considering that the same transmitter works fine with the same receiver with one version and not with the other.
